items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's Lawrence Welk right across from you in an article; and Lee Castle.

ctx.x: do much longer, but I still made those trips regularly, from east to west and if we didn't play anywhere else, we at least made that chain of the negro theatres that all the bands made.
There's Lawrence Welk right across from you in an article; and Lee Castle.
To tell you the truth, most likely the same man that was booking, before Lawrence got so big, Frederick Brothers was booking me about the same time they were booking Lawrence Welk.
